name: Trick Animate
original_name: トリック・アニマート
source:
We'll say it once more just for you, dummy...
Trick or treat!
Spare your words. You have no choice in the matter!
Sit still and give us your blood!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7853]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我们会为你再说一遍，笨蛋……
不给糖就捣蛋！
省点话吧。在这件事上你别无选择！
坐下来，给我们你的血！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7853]Freem![/url]]
